children: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition reported a net income swing year over year, as trust-account interest income of $1.7M more than offset $199,550 in general and administrative expenses and a $113,226 unrealized loss on trust-account securities; the prior-year quarter's loss reflected $29,278 of general and administrative expenses and $522 of share-based compensation.
: The company continued identifying a target; it has not selected a specific business combination target.
: Trust-account interest income was $1.7M, while unrealized losses on marketable securities were $113,226.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $593,780 at September 30, 2026; management said available funds may not cover operating expenses for the next 12 months.
: The company has until November 10, 2027 to complete a business combination or, absent an extension, cease operations and liquidate.
